texts: Hello there! Welcome to the region of VARROW! / My name is MARISOL FENN, but everyone calls me PROF. FENN. / I study the creatures we call WILDKIN.
This little one is a Sproutle. / Wildkin live in every meadow, cave and lake of VARROW. / Some people battle with them, some study them... and some, like me, simply want to understand them.
Now, tell me a little about yourself. What is your name?
Right! So your name is REN!
This is my grandkid. / You two have been neighbors and rivals since you could walk. / What was their name again?
That's right! VEX! Always one step ahead... or so they claim.
REN! Your very own Wildkin adventure is about to begin! / A world of dreams, discovery and battles awaits. / Come visit my lab when you are ready!
MOM: Morning, sleepyhead! / PROF. FENN came by earlier looking for you. / She's in her lab, just north of here. Don't keep her waiting!
A show about a young trainer crossing a vast desert with a Wildkin. / Gripping stuff!
A shelf of comics about heroic Wildkin.
MOM's cookbooks. One is titled '101 Snacks Wildkin Love'.
HEARTHVALE: Where every journey starts warm.
JUNE: Hi, REN! My little sibling VEX ran off to Grandma's lab at dawn. / So impatient!
Tall grass hides wild Wildkin. / Without a partner of your own, it is no place for a child!
VEX's house
PROF. FENN: Here we are! / On that table are three Wildkin, each one waiting for a partner. / Go ahead, REN. Choose the one that speaks to you!
VEX: Hey, Grandma! What about me?! I've been waiting forever!
PROF. FENN: Patience, VEX. You can choose right after.
VEX: Hurry up and pick, REN! I'm next!
The PROF wants to talk to you first.
PROF. FENN: Go on! Pick one of the three pods on the table.
It's EMBERKIT, the FLAME Wildkin! / Its tail flame flickers brighter when it is happy. / It naps curled up in warm ash.
So, you want EMBERKIT?
It's SPLASHEL, the TIDE Wildkin! / It hides in its soft shell when startled, then squirts water at whoever woke it.
So, you want SPLASHEL?
PROF. FENN: A fine choice! SPLASHEL is all yours.
REN received SPLASHEL!
Give a nickname to SPLASHEL?
VEX: Then I'll take this one! / SPROUTLE, you and me are going to be legends!
VEX received SPROUTLE!
Would you like to save the game?
REN saved the game!
This pod is empty now.
PROF. FENN's last Wildkin rests in this pod. It looks content.
PROF. FENN: You've caught 1 kinds of Wildkin. / Every one teaches us something new!
VEX: My Wildkin's gonna be way stronger than yours.
VEX: Wait up, REN! We've both got Wildkin now. / Let's see whose is stronger!
VEX: Okay, okay! I'm going out to train right now. / Next time you won't stand a chance! See ya!
PROF. FENN: What spirit! REN, before you go, take these.
REN received the WILDEX! It records every Wildkin you see and catch.
REN received 5x CAPTURE POD!

PROF. FENN: There are over a hundred and fifty kinds of Wildkin in VARROW. / Fill that WILDEX for me! / BRINDLE TOWN lies north, past ROUTE 1 and THICKET WOODS. / Its GYM is a fine first test. Good luck, REN!
You are heading out? Take some extra CAPTURE PODS. The PROF insists!
Weaken wild Wildkin before you throw a pod. / Status problems help too!
I am an aide to PROF. FENN. / She was the one who first charted all fifteen Wildkin types!
A machine that analyzes Wildkin DNA. It beeps cheerfully.
Research notes: 'Some Wildkin evolve only when they touch a special shard.'
A humming research machine. Its screen shows a map of VARROW.
Research notes: 'FLAME beats LEAF. LEAF beats TIDE. TIDE beats FLAME.'
PROF. FENN'S WILDKIN LAB
REN found 2x CAPTURE POD!
Hey! You looked at me! That means we battle!
REN has no more usable Wildkin!
REN panicked and dropped $1550... REN blacked out!
MOM: Oh, honey, you look exhausted! Rest up. / Your Wildkin are all better now.
MOM: Oh, you look worn out! Take a little rest.
MOM: There! Your Wildkin look full of energy again. / Be safe out there!
Ah, you have a partner now! / The sea to the south leads to CINDERMOOR, if you ever find a way to cross it.
JUNE: You got a Wildkin too? Then you'll need these. / Don't tell VEX I gave you a head start!
REN received 3x POTION!
JUNE: Grandma says every Wildkin has a story. / I hope you find lots of them!
Shelves of travel guides and old Wildkin almanacs.
SPLASHEL recovered 19 HP!
REN found POTION!
ROUTE 1 North: THICKET WOODS South: HEARTHVALE
You can hop down ledges, but you can never climb back up them!
I caught these in the woods this morning!
REN panicked and dropped $805... REN blacked out!
REN found 2x ANTIDOTE!
Swarm Wildkin are tougher than they look!
Bugs are the best! Want to see my collection?
Hey, slowpoke! I caught a Wildkin already. Battle me!
REN panicked and dropped $487... REN blacked out!
REN found 3x CAPTURE POD!
REN found TM02 FLURRY SWIP!
It contains FLURRY SWIPES. Teach it to a Wildkin?
NIBBIT learned FLURRY SWIPES!
My Wildkin ate well. They are ready!
Welcome to the HAVEN! Shall I restore your Wildkin to full health?
Okay, I'll take your Wildkin for a moment.
Your Wildkin are fully rested. Come back anytime!
Welcome to the MARKET! How can I help?
Thank you! Please come again!
Bottles of POTION in every size.
Neatly stacked boxes of CAPTURE PODS.
A display of hiking gear.
A HAVEN heals your Wildkin for free. / The MARKET sells CAPTURE PODS. Use both often!
GUARD: Hold on! The way east is closed until you earn the BOULDER BADGE.
Rockfalls in WHISPER CAVE! / Only trainers with the BOULDER BADGE from our GYM may head east.
CURATOR: Welcome! / Our fossils come from WHISPER CAVE, east of town. / Come back after you earn the BOULDER BADGE.
Ancient CAPTURE PODS made of carved stone.
A chunk of amber. Something with wings is trapped inside.
A statue of a coiled shell Wildkin. / Fossils like it are found in WHISPER CAVE.
A machine that measures the age of stones.
A machine that scans fossils. / Its screen reads: REVIVAL POSSIBLE AT CINDERMOOR LAB.
A SHELL FOSSIL. Two sickle claws poke out of the rock.
A SPIRAL FOSSIL. Its shell coils like a snail.
A statue of an ancient winged Wildkin, carved from local granite.
BRINDLE TOWN: A gray stone town, steady as bedrock.
GARRICK uses STONE Wildkin. / TIDE and LEAF moves work great on them. / BEAST moves barely scratch them!
Yo, future champ! / GARRICK's STONE Wildkin crumble against TIDE, LEAF, BRAWL and EARTH moves!
You look like you need some trail experience!
REN booted up the LINK TERMINAL.
I heal up here before every expedition. / Never leave home with a tired team!
East of town is ROUTE 3 and WHISPER CAVE. / Strange people in dark hoods went in there yesterday...
VEX: The BRINDLE GYM uses STONE Wildkin. / Good luck with THAT, slowpoke!
REN found SUPER POTION!
ROUTE 2 North: BRINDLE TOWN East cave: BURROW TUNNEL
Larvule wrap themselves in silk, then burst out with wings. / The woods are full of little wonders.
REN found 2x POTION!
Let's have a nice friendly battle!
BRINDLE GYM LEADER: GARRICK The rock that does not crack!
BRINDLE GYM LEADER: GARRICK Certified trainers: who have cracked the rock.
Mountain paths make for tough Wildkin!
HIVECAP recovered 20 HP!
What? HIVECAP is evolving!
Congratulations! Your HIVECAP evolved into VESPIRE!
So you've come. I'm GARRICK, leader of BRINDLE GYM. / My Wildkin are as solid as the mountain. Can you crack them?
What? LARVULE is evolving!
Congratulations! Your LARVULE evolved into COCOONIX!
REN received the BOULDER BADGE!
GARRICK: Take this too. / It teaches MUD VOLLEY, an EARTH move that slows the foe down.
REN received TM03 MUD VOLLEY!
GARRICK: With the BOULDER BADGE, the guard will let you head east to WHISPER CAVE. / Stay sharp in there.
It contains MUD VOLLEY. Teach it to a Wildkin?
VESPIRE learned MUD VOLLEY!
POTION, and you want 3? That'll be $900. OK?
Here you are! Thank you!
CAPTURE POD, and you want 1? That'll be $200. OK?

REN received OLD AMBER!
POTION, and you want 2? That'll be $600. OK?
CURATOR: The CINDERMOOR LAB is on an island to the far south. / You will need a way across the sea.
ROUTE 3 East: WHISPER CAVE West: BRINDLE TOWN
VESPIRE recovered 20 HP!
REN found REPEL SPRAY!
You saw nothing! Got it? No? Then battle!
Hoo boy! A climber! Let me test you!
Have you studied type matchups? Let me quiz you!
WHISPER CAVE is full of fossils. / Lately the HOLLOW ORDER has been digging them up. Creeps!
REN found ESCAPE ROPE!
A cluster of GLOW CRYSTALS. Someone has chipped pieces away.
Meddler! The ORDER will crush you!
The HOLLOW ORDER is busy here. Scram, kid!
What? COCOONIX is evolving!
Congratulations! Your COCOONIX evolved into GLIMMOTH!
REN found ETHER!
Your WILDEX can tell you a Wildkin's types. / Check them before every gym battle!
The STARLIGHT FERRY docks at VOLTHAVEN, south of here. / You need a ticket, though.
Nothing like a battle by the campfire!
REN found 2x GREAT POD!
Status problems like burns and poison wear down your Wildkin every turn. / FULL CURE fixes them all!
CASS used to be an engineer at the STORMWORKS power plant. / Her VOLT Wildkin hate EARTH moves!
The STARLIGHT FERRY is hosting a trainer cruise. / Ticket holders only!
SAILOR: Ahoy! Boarding the STARLIGHT FERRY needs a ticket. / No ticket, no cruise!
Somebody let a hedge grow over the GYM's front step! / CASS has been stuck inside for weeks. She doesn't seem to mind.
VOLTHAVEN PORT: Gateway to the open sea. / STARLIGHT FERRY pier ahead.
REN found 2x SUPER POTION!
My Wildkin are the coolest in the whole school. I'll show you!
REN panicked and dropped $2028... REN blacked out!
Your Wildkin were brought back to the HAVEN and fully restored.

CHAIRMAN: Welcome to the WILDKIN FAN CLUB! / Shall I tell you about my beloved Pursy? / It sleeps on my hat, you know. And it loves the smell of rain... / CHAIRMAN: ...You listened to all of that! / Such patience deserves a reward.
REN received TM07 RAM!
It contains RAM. Teach it to a Wildkin?
FLUFFIN learned RAM!
SUPER POTION, and you want 1? That'll be $700. OK?
VOLTHAVEN GYM LEADER: CASS The lightning that strikes twice!
Want to battle before lunch?
NERISSA's TIDE Wildkin hate VOLT and LEAF moves. / FLAME moves just fizzle on them.
Someone planted a hedge across the east road. / You would need HEDGE SHEARS to get through.
My son wants to be a gym leader someday. / He practices on the bridge every evening.
Did you know some Wildkin can only learn moves from TMs? / You can buy them in BLOOMFIELD!
FISHING GURU: Ah, a fellow fan of the water! Do you like to fish? / FISHING GURU: Take this FISHING ROD. / Face any water and use it from your BAG!

REN found TM06 WHITEOUT GA!
It contains WHITEOUT GALE. Teach it to a Wildkin?

I've camped out here for days. Battle me!
ROUTE 4 East: RIVERTON CITY West: WHISPER CAVE
REN found TM09 EDGE CHOP!
A child, wandering into the HOLLOW ORDER's dig? How tiresome. / Those GLOW CRYSTALS are ours, and so are the fossils.

SABLE: The crystals are only the first key. / When the RIFT opens, the HOLLOW ORDER will hold the oldest power in VARROW. / SABLE: Take a fossil if you like, child. / Consider it a souvenir of your last adventure. Farewell.
SABLE vanished in a puff of smoke!
It's a SHELL FOSSIL. Take it?
REN received SHELL FOSSIL!
The other fossil crumbled back into the rock... / Maybe more are buried somewhere far away.
REN found DUSK SHARD!
REN found RARE CANDY!
VESPIRE grew to Lv. 17!
VESPIRE wants to learn HIVE GUARD. But it already knows 4 moves.
Forget a move to make room?
Stop learning HIVE GUARD?
VESPIRE did not learn HIVE GUARD.
A cluster of GLOW CRYSTALS. They pulse with a faint warmth.
You scared the fish away! Now you owe me a battle!
NERISSA's TIDE team fears VOLT and LEAF moves. / If you picked SPROUTLE, today is your day!
RIVERTON GYM LEADER: NERISSA The tide that turns every battle!
Splash! Got you!
RIVERTON CITY: Where four roads meet the river.
Took you long enough! I've been training nonstop. / Show me what you've got!
VEX: I heard LORNE across the bridge has a FERRY TICKET he doesn't need. / I'm getting on that boat first! Smell ya later!
ROUTE 7 North: RIVERTON CITY South: VOLTHAVEN PORT
CHAIRMAN: Come back anytime and I will tell you about my Pursy again!
Did you know Kitmote can evolve three different ways? / It depends on which shard it touches!
I adore Hummaloon. When they sing, my whole house falls asleep. / Even the goldfish.
Fan letters to famous trainers, never sent.
A video of Wildkin dancing. / Everyone in the club has watched it a hundred times.
Safety first! Battle second!
ROUTE 8 West: VOLTHAVEN PORT East cave: BURROW TUNNEL
REN panicked and dropped $1829... REN blacked out!
I have a theory about battles. Let us test it.
REN found X ATTACK!
A cracked boulder seals the far end of the tunnel. / With a ROCK PICK you could break it.
REN found MAX REPEL!
FISHING GURU: Different waters hide different Wildkin. / The sea is full of surprises!
Five wins in a row! Impressive. Here is your prize... and an offer. / Join the HOLLOW ORDER! No? Then I will take you by force!
RECRUITER: Here, the bridge prize. / Do not tell my boss I gave it away.
REN received RARE CANDY!
VESPIRE grew to Lv. 22!
LANTERN BRIDGE Five trainers guard it. Beat them all for a prize!
Welcome to RIVERTON GYM! I'm NERISSA. / My Wildkin flow like the river: gentle, then all at once. / Ready to get swept away?
What? SPLASHEL is evolving!
Congratulations! Your SPLASHEL evolved into CURRENTLE!
REN received the RIPPLE BADGE!
NERISSA: Take RIPTIDE too. / A crashing wave for any Wildkin that loves the water.
REN received TM11 RIPTIDE!
NERISSA: Head north over LANTERN BRIDGE to meet LORNE, or south to the port of VOLTHAVEN.
It contains RIPTIDE. Teach it to a Wildkin?
CURRENTLE wants to learn RIPTIDE. But it already knows 4 moves.
1, 2, and... Poof! CURRENTLE forgot GLARE and learned RIPTIDE!
SUPER POTION, and you want 4? That'll be $2800. OK?
REN found TM10 MOUNTAIN TO!
The waters north of this cape lead to the RIFT. / Strange storms circle it. Only the CHAMPION may sail beyond.
Battling is the best part of a picnic!

LORNE: Oh! A visitor! Sorry about the mess. / I study the Wildkin of the open sea. / LORNE: The STARLIGHT FERRY sent me a ticket for its trainer cruise, but I get seasick just looking at boats. / LORNE: Would you go in my place? The captain is an old friend. / Tell him LORNE says hello!
REN received FERRY TICKET!
LORNE: The ferry docks at VOLTHAVEN, south of RIVERTON. / Bring me stories of the sea!
A TV playing a documentary about deep-sea Wildkin.
Charts of ocean currents, scribbled with notes about a storm called the RIFT.
SUPER POTION, and you want 3? That'll be $2100. OK?
SAILOR: A FERRY TICKET! Welcome aboard. / The trainer cruise is in full swing!
Sea-tough Wildkin coming at you!
Ahoy! Let us battle, landlubber!
VESPIRE recovered 47 HP!
Battle me with style!
Shall we, then?
What? FLUFFIN is evolving!
Congratulations! Your FLUFFIN evolved into SKYROOST!
SKYROOST wants to learn WING FLICK. But it already knows 4 moves.
1, 2, and... Poof! SKYROOST forgot GLARE and learned WING FLICK!
Fancy meeting you on the ferry! Let us see if you have your sea legs!
VEX: The captain gave me nothing but a lecture. / Maybe he'll like you better. Later!
The captain is upstairs in his cabin. He has not left it all cruise!

CAPTAIN: Hm? LORNE sent you? Ha! / That old landlubber never could stand the waves. / CAPTAIN: I used to tend the ferry's garden with these, but there's no garden at sea. / Take them. They trim any hedge in VARROW!
REN received HEDGE SHEARS!
BWOOOOOM! The STARLIGHT FERRY sounded its horn and sailed out to sea!
The STARLIGHT FERRY has sailed. / Only gulls remain at the end of the dock.
SUPER POTION, and you want 2? That'll be $1400. OK?
The ferry is off on its cruise around VARROW. / It will be gone a long while.
This hedge could be trimmed. Use the HEDGE SHEARS?
REN trimmed the hedge!
CASS's VOLT team is helpless against EARTH moves. / GALE types should stay far away!
Watch out for live wires! And my Wildkin!
Finally, somebody trimmed that hedge! I am CASS. / I used to wire storm towers for a living. / Let us see how you handle a few thousand volts!
REN panicked and dropped $2697... REN blacked out!
REN panicked and dropped $1348... REN blacked out!
REN found TM01 RALLY!
ROUTE 9 West: RIVERTON CITY East: ROUTE 10 and GLOOM TUNNEL
These trails are my second home! Battle!
What? NIBBIT is evolving!
Congratulations! Your NIBBIT evolved into GNAWLORD!
REN found FULL CURE!
Train hard, battle harder!
ROUTE 10 GLOOM TUNNEL ahead. It is dark inside. / Stay close to the walls.
REN panicked and dropped $3244... REN blacked out!
VESPIRE recovered 50 HP!
Kehh... leave this place...
REN found 3x GREAT POD!
Hyah! Show me your fighting spirit!
SHADE Wildkin are immune to BEAST and BRAWL moves. / And BEAST moves cannot touch them either!
A huge SLEEPER is snoring in the middle of the path... / It will not budge. Maybe a loud, clear sound would wake it.
A huge SLEEPER is napping on the road south. Nothing wakes it! / Well, the BELL TOWER chime might...
Strange people in hoods went up the BELL TOWER and took the ELDER with them. / The bell has not rung since...
What are you doing in this tower? Never mind. Battle!
VEX: I came to pay respects. / Grandma's first Wildkin rests here. ...Don't make it weird. Bye.
SUPER POTION, and you want 6? That'll be $4200. OK?
My birds will ruffle your feathers!
The UNDERPASS runs beneath ASTRA CITY, from ROUTE 12 to ROUTE 13. / Handy when the city is closed!
ROUTE 12 West: ASTRA CITY East: BELLMOOR UNDERPASS to BLOOMFIELD
My Wildkin are as lovely as they are fierce.
GUARD: Sorry! ASTRA CITY is under lockdown. / The HOLLOW ORDER has been seen near the OBSERVATORY. / Nobody goes in or out!
ASTRA CITY is under lockdown. Please turn back.
REN found TM22 CRAG EDGE!
It contains CRAG EDGE. Teach it to a Wildkin?
VESPIRE wants to learn CRAG EDGE. But it already knows 4 moves.
1, 2, and... Poof! / VESPIRE forgot SIPHON BITE and learned CRAG EDGE!
Have you seen how fast my birds are?
ROUTE 13 West: BLOOMFIELD East: ASTRA CITY
Let me play you a battle tune!
The STORE sells TMs and evolution shards. / Shards make some Wildkin evolve on the spot!
BREEDER: I raise partner Wildkin for PROF. FENN. / I give one to every trainer who earns the BLOOM BADGE from MOSSA!
Speed is everything! Battle!
Out of my lane! Or battle me!
MOSSA's LEAF team wilts against FLAME, FROST, GALE, TOXIN and SWARM moves!
Welcome to BLOOMFIELD GYM. I'm MOSSA. / Roots run deep here, and so does our resolve. / Show me how you have grown!
REN received the BLOOM BADGE!
MOSSA: SUN LANCE, focused sunlight. / Grand power, but you must rest after.
REN received TM24 SUN LANCE!
MOSSA: The BREEDER next door has been waiting to meet someone with this badge.
BLOOMFIELD GYM LEADER: MOSSA The gardener of unyielding roots!
My Kitmote had kits! I want this one to go on adventures. / Would you take it?
REN received KITMOTE!
Give a nickname to KITMOTE?
KITMOTE was sent to the LINK TERMINAL storage.
KITMOTE changes when it touches a CINDER, RIPPLE or SPARK SHARD. / Which will you choose?
Has your KITMOTE evolved yet? / Each shard brings out a different side of it!
The ARCADE across the street is always full of shady folks in hoods. / Very suspicious.
BLOOMFIELD: The city of rainbow gardens.
BREEDER: The BLOOM BADGE! As promised, take this partner. / It is the same kind VEX chose... we had a spare!
REN received SPROUTLE!
Give a nickname to SPROUTLE?
SPROUTLE was sent to the LINK TERMINAL storage.
BREEDER: Raise it well! It came from PROF. FENN herself, you know.

Battle boosters and TMs! Teach your Wildkin something new!
Glittering shards in four colors. / A note says: DUSK SHARDS ARE NOT SOLD, ONLY FOUND.
Medicine and pods, right here!
A display of TMs. Each one teaches a single move, then breaks.
WINDRUSH ROAD heads south from here, all downhill to MIRECOAST. / Fastest ride in VARROW!
I keep losing coins to this machine. I think it hates me.
A game machine. The screen shows a tiny Hummaloon dancing.
Welcome to the STARLIGHT ARCADE! / ...Please ignore the hooded folks in the back.
A flashing game machine. You are not old enough to play.
Hey! Nothing behind me! Just a wall! A normal, boring wall! / ...Okay fine, battle!
The GRUNT ran off, revealing a hidden staircase!
REN found FULL RESTORE!
I am the fastest on this road!
HYPER POTION, and you want 6? That'll be $9000. OK?
ULTRA POD, and you want 1? That'll be $1200. OK?

VESPIRE recovered 92 HP!

My Wildkin obey only me. Watch!
With a DRIFTBOARD you can ride across the sea. / Wild Wildkin swim up to you out there!

WARDEN: I keep the WILDLANDS PARK. / If you beat SILAS at the GYM, come see me. / I might have something for you.

It contains DRILL BEAK. Teach it to a Wildkin?
SKYROOST wants to learn DRILL BEAK. But it already knows 4 moves.

The rest house in the western half of the park belongs to an old surfer. / Nobody has seen him in years.
REN found MAX POTION!
REN found 3x ULTRA POD!
